definitions.explanation: A clever or resourceful way of solving a problem or improving something. The act of thinking up ways to achieve a goal.

examples.japanese: {工夫|くふう}{次第|しだい}で{何|なん}とかなる。
examples.english: With some ingenuity, we can manage somehow.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}を{節約|せつやく}する{工夫|くふう}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: We need to devise ways to save time.

examples.japanese: {狭|せま}い{部屋|へや}を{広|ひろ}く{見|み}せる{工夫|くふう}をした。
examples.english: I came up with ways to make the small room look bigger.

notes:
PATTERNS:
・{工夫|くふう}する (to devise, to contrive)
・{工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らす (to exercise ingenuity)
・{工夫|くふう}{次第|しだい}で (depending on how you devise it)
・{工夫|くふう}が{足|た}りない (lacking ingenuity)

USAGE:
・ちょっとした{工夫|くふう} (a small trick/idea)
・{自分|じぶん}なりの{工夫|くふう} (one's own device/method)
・{創意|そうい}{工夫|くふう} (creative ingenuity)

HOMOPHONE NOTE: {工夫|こうふ} (laborer, workman) has a different reading.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・アイデア/アイディア (idea - loanword)
・{知恵|ちえ} (wisdom, cleverness)
・{方法|ほうほう} (method, way)
